from.name: Field Trip Permission
from.description: A parent or guardian's permission for a school field trip, with emergency contact, allergies and medical consent.

body.p: Trip: {{trip}}, on {{trip_date}}. Cost: ${{cost}}, payable to the school office before the trip.
I give permission for the student named above to take part in this trip, travel with school staff and follow their directions.
Name: [[text:Parent or Guardian:Emergency contact name]]  Phone: [[text:Parent or Guardian:Emergency contact phone]]
Allergies or medical needs staff should know about: [[text?:Parent or Guardian:Allergies and medical needs]]
[[check:Parent or Guardian:Medical consent]] In an emergency, I authorize staff to obtain medical treatment for the student if I cannot be reached.

name: Field Trip Permission
summary: A NEW document written inline (not a library document template): a parent or guardian gives permission for a school trip, with an emergency contact, allergies and a medical consent; it expires in 7 days with a warning 2 days before. Sent in bulk: one envelope per student, the student, trip, date and cost from the list.
emailBlurb: Please complete the emergency contact and sign the permission slip.
